description: Trunk: establish authenticated session for cc_manager role QA account (qa-test-comc-manager@phronex.com). Required by journeys that test manager-level RBAC boundaries.

steps.description: MANAGER TRUNK FRESH LOGIN — DO NOT load any browser state file. This journey CREATES the session. Start fresh: use browser_tabs to close all tabs except the current one. Use browser_evaluate to wipe the service worker cache: 'await caches.keys().then(ks => Promise.all(ks.map(k => caches.delete(k))))'. Then navigate directly to http://localhost:3002/auth/login?t=Date.now() (cache-bust). VERIFY the login form is visible (email+password fields must be present in the snapshot). Fill email 'qa-test-comc-manager@phronex.com' and password 'v492kb-JXn5Sso1TEKApd2wi9LE'. Submit and wait for the portal sidebar to appear or redirect to /command-centre/dashboard. Mark failed if redirected back to /auth/login (wrong credentials) or if a 500 error appears.

Verify this session has manager-level access, not CEO-only access. Use browser_network_request to GET http://localhost:3002/api/admin/command-centre/api/v1/meetings/upcoming — expect 200 with a JSON array (meetings endpoint uses require_manager, so cc_manager can access it). Then use browser_network_request to GET http://localhost:3002/api/admin/command-centre/api/v1/agents — expect 403 with detail 'CEO role required' (agents endpoint uses require_ceo, which cc_manager does NOT satisfy). PASS if meetings/upcoming=200 AND agents=403. FAIL if agents returns 200 (account has CEO-level access, not manager-level) or if meetings/upcoming returns 403 (cc_manager role was not correctly granted).

CRITICAL — Save browser session state with cookies. Call the mcp__cctr-playwright__browser_storage_state tool with filename "/home/ouroborous/code/phronex-test-runner/.tmp/comc-trunk-manager-state.json". After calling the tool, VERIFY the file was correctly saved by using browser_run_code to execute: const fs = require('fs'); const d = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/home/ouroborous/code/phronex-test-runner/.tmp/comc-trunk-manager-state.json', 'utf8')); console.log('cookies:', d.cookies ? d.cookies.length : 0); If the cookies count is 0 (empty state), the primary tool failed — use browser_run_code as the FALLBACK to save actual storage state: const fs = require('fs'); const state = await page.context().storageState(); fs.writeFileSync('/home/ouroborous/code/phronex-test-runner/.tmp/comc-trunk-manager-state.json', JSON.stringify(state)); console.log('saved cookies:', state.cookies.length); Mark this step FAILED if the final file still has 0 cookies — an empty state file will cause all dependent manager-role leaf journeys to fail.

steps.description: Load superadmin session from '/home/ouroborous/code/phronex-test-runner/.tmp/comc-trunk-superadmin-state.json'. Navigate to http://localhost:3002/command-centre/briefs. Verify the page loads with HTTP 200 and shows a 'Brief History' heading or similar brief list UI. If session expired (redirected to login), re-authenticate as superadmin and navigate back. FAIL if page returns 500 or shows an error state.

On the briefs page, verify the API call succeeds: open browser Network tab, confirm GET http://localhost:3002/api/admin/command-centre/api/v1/briefs returns HTTP 200 with a JSON array. The array may be empty (no briefs generated yet) — an empty array is a PASS. FAIL only if the response is 500, 404, or non-JSON.

Navigate to http://localhost:3002/command-centre/briefs/settings. Verify the page loads with HTTP 200. Confirm the settings page shows brief configuration options (section toggles, delivery time, or similar). Verify GET http://localhost:3002/api/admin/command-centre/api/v1/briefs/settings returns HTTP 200 with a JSON object containing configuration keys. FAIL if 404 or 500.

On the briefs settings page, toggle any available section switch (e.g., enable or disable a brief section). Submit the change. Verify the PUT request to http://localhost:3002/api/admin/command-centre/api/v1/briefs/settings returns HTTP 200. Reload the page (F5) and confirm the toggled setting persisted. FAIL if the setting reverts after reload.

Navigate to http://localhost:3002/command-centre/intelligence-briefs. Verify this page loads with HTTP 200 and shows an intelligence briefs view (may show empty state if no intelligence briefs exist — that is valid). Confirm the URL is distinct from /command-centre/briefs (different feature surface). FAIL only on 500 or redirect to login.

Navigate away to http://localhost:3002/command-centre (dashboard). Wait 2 seconds. Navigate back to http://localhost:3002/command-centre/briefs. Verify the briefs list page loads with HTTP 200 and no 500 errors in the network log. Use browser_network_request to GET http://localhost:3002/api/admin/command-centre/api/v1/briefs and confirm it returns HTTP 200 with a JSON array (same as step 2). PASS if the page loads cleanly and the API returns 200. This tests navigation persistence — the page state should survive a round-trip to the dashboard.
